I checked the ArraySelectExplorer query preset ('query-functions', mode 'query', target f, dimension 1, in src/lib/sv-array-select-model.ts) against IEEE 1800-2023 §20.7 and §20.7.1. Fixed dimensions follow the $increment rule (1 when $left >= $right, else -1). Queue and dynamic dimensions give $left 0, $increment -1, and $right -1 when the queue is empty. Integral-index associative dimensions give $left 0, $right 2147483647 (the highest int index, int being 32-bit signed per §6.11), $low/$high as the lowest/highest allocated key or 'x when empty, $increment -1, and $size as the allocated count. Predefined-width int counts as one packed [31:0] dimension. Out-of-range dimensions return 'x. For bit [31:0] exp_by_id [int][$], $dimensions is 3 and $unpacked_dimensions is 2. A per-dimension call on dimension 2 is an error under §20.7.1, the model suggests $size(exp_by_id[5], 1) = 2 instead, and dimension 3 is legal. All of this matches the LRM, the lesson's prediction table and the dimension-numbering figure above the embed. No S1 or S2 found.
